title: Microsoft Teams: customise the recording and transcription notification text
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the launched roadmap item from Learn's narrower meeting documentation and its warning about the PowerShell route. The control paths, parameters and licensing statement are supported; policy-assignment guidance needs a citation and is not represented in the controls table.

claims.where: What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap describes IT admins customising a portion of recording and transcription notifications during Teams calls.
claims.quote: This feature enables IT admins to customize a portion of the user notification messages for recording and transcription during Teams calls.

claims.where: front matter: status; summary; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap status is Launched.
claims.quote: "status": "Launched"

claims.where: front matter: targetDate; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap target is August CY2026.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "August CY2026"

claims.where: front matter: previewDate
claims.claim: The roadmap gives no preview date.
claims.quote: "previewDate": null

claims.where: front matter: releasePhase; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The release phases are General Availability and Targeted Release.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability", "Targeted Release"]

claims.where: front matter: clouds; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap lists Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), GCC, GCC High and DoD.
claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)", "GCC", "GCC High", "DoD"]

claims.where: front matter: platforms; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap platforms are Desktop, Mac and Web.
claims.quote: "platforms": ["Desktop", "Mac", "Web"]

claims.where: front matter: products
claims.claim: The record associates the item with Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365).
claims.quote: "products": ["Microsoft Teams", "Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)"]

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Teams administrators can customise the recording and transcription consent message for meetings.
claims.quote: IT admins can customize the Recording and Transcription message and the URL of the privacy policy

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: Teams shows a notification banner when recording or transcription starts.
claims.quote: When recording or transcription starts, Teams displays a notification banner composed of four elements.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Administrators can change the privacy policy URL.
claims.quote: Resource (Privacy policy) URL (#4): Only the URL can be changed.

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: The privacy policy link's display text is fixed as Privacy policy.
claims.quote: The display text "Privacy policy" is fixed and cannot be modified.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Banner consent messages support plain text and HTML links.
claims.quote: Consent message (#3): Supports plain text and HTML <a> tags for adding multiple custom links.

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: In explicit-consent meetings, Teams displays a consent dialog when a user unmutes or turns on the camera.
claims.quote: For meetings that require explicit consent, Teams displays a consent dialog when a user unmutes/turns on the camera.

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: The explicit-consent dialog's custom consent message supports plain text only.
claims.quote: Customizable consent message (#3): Only supports plain text, HTML <a> tag is not supported.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: A CSV template supplies custom messages by scenario and language.
claims.quote: First column: Supported languages (refer here to see all the supported languages). First row: Notification scenarios you can customize.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Custom messages cannot exceed 200 characters.
claims.quote: Custom messages can't exceed 200 characters; longer messages aren't permitted.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Fixed information, including the initiator's name and privacy policy, remains in notifications.
claims.quote: The message you set appears in the notification for the corresponding scenarios, along with fixed information (such as the initiator’s name and privacy policy) that is always included.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; Scope; Open questions; controls[2].note
claims.claim: Learn's feature page says custom messages are not supported in 1:1 calls.
claims.quote: Custom messages are not supported in 1:1 calls.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Teams uses its default message for a language or scenario with no custom message.
claims.quote: If there's no custom message for a specific language or scenario, the user sees the default message in Teams.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; Governance controls; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Users assigned an enabled meeting policy see its custom notifications in meetings they organise.
claims.quote: Once the custom message is enabled for a meeting policy, all users assigned to that policy see the custom notifications in meetings they organize.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; Governance controls; rationale: impact
claims.claim: All participants in those meetings follow the organiser's custom-message settings.
claims.quote: All participants in those meetings follow the organizer’s custom message settings.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Putting <empty> in a language or scenario leaves only fixed information in the notification.
claims.quote: you can insert `<empty>` for the specific language or scenario. In this case, the notification shows only the fixed information.

claims.where: Scope: Platforms
claims.claim: Learn documents support for Teams Windows, macOS and Web clients.
claims.quote: Custom messages are supported on Teams Windows, macOS, and Web clients.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Scope; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn says iOS and Android currently support plain text only, with full message customisability coming soon.
claims.quote: iOS and Android currently support plain text only, with full message customizability coming soon.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: For some non-English system languages, Excel's delimiter can cause CSV formatting problems and Microsoft advises using a plain text editor.
claims.quote: To avoid formatting issues, admins using these system languages should edit the CSV template using another plain text editor. Please do not edit or re-save the CSV file using Excel.

claims.where: Scope: Languages; What's changing
claims.claim: Learn lists supported language codes and chooses the message using the participant's client language and scenario.
claims.quote: The message displayed depends on the scenario and the participant’s client language.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The meeting-policy toggle is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & transcription > Show customized in-meeting notification for recording and transcription.
claims.quote: Navigate to Meetings → Meeting policies. Select or create a meeting policy where you want to enable custom messages. In the Recording & transcription section, find the new setting: Show customized in-meeting notification for recording and transcription.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -EnableRecordingAndTranscriptionCustomMessage $true sets the Boolean custom-message option.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy [[-Identity] <XdsIdentity>] ... [-EnableRecordingAndTranscriptionCustomMessage <Boolean>]

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The message editor is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & transcription > Customize notification.
claims.quote: In the Recording & transcription section, find the new setting: Show customized in-meeting notification for recording and transcription. Use the toggle to enable or disable custom messages for this policy. ... Click the Customize notification button to set your custom message.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -RecordingAndTranscriptionCustomMessageIdentifier <guid> selects the custom message identifier.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy [[-Identity] <XdsIdentity>] ... [-RecordingAndTranscriptionCustomMessageIdentifier <Guid>]

claims.where: controls[2].api; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -EnableRecordingAndTranscriptionCustomMessage $true sets a documented calling-policy parameter, without confirming call-notification behaviour.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy [-Identity] <string> ... [-EnableRecordingAndTranscriptionCustomMessage <Boolean>]

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Open questions
claims.claim: A Teams admin center setting for calling-policy custom notification messages is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams calling policies customize notification recording transcription custom message admin center group calls. Opened teams-calling-policy, call-recording-transcription-captions and recording-transcription-custom-message; no calling-policy custom-message UI documented.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the custom-notification setting's default or announced a default change to existing notifications.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams custom recording transcription notification EnableRecordingAndTranscriptionCustomMessage default enabled disabled. Read feature page, meeting/calling parameter excerpts and New custom-message reference; none states a service default or automatic notification change.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model, licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The included model uses the general Teams licence requirement, except for joining meetings anonymously.
claims.quote: Except for joining Teams meetings anonymously, each user in your organization must have a Teams license before they can use Teams.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No additional licence requirement specific to custom notifications is published at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams custom in-meeting notification recording transcription Teams Premium license pricing meter. Read feature page, Manage Teams licenses, recording overview and Teams Premium licensing search excerpt; no additional custom-notification licence requirement found.

claims.where: rationale: cost; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: No feature-specific meter is published, so the identified cost is administrative work rather than a documented consumption charge.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams custom in-meeting notification recording transcription Teams Premium license pricing meter. Read feature page, Manage Teams licenses and recording overview; no custom-notification meter or charge found.

claims.where: Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Other recording-related options have Teams Premium or Copilot licensing, which the cited overview does not apply to custom notifications.
claims.quote: Intelligent recap for meetings (Teams Premium and Microsoft Copilot) ... Users with a Teams Premium or Microsoft Copilot license automatically have access to this feature.

claims.where: Governance controls
claims.claim: The feature's Learn page does not name a required administrator role.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams recording transcription custom message permissions role data access recording start stop. Read the complete recording-transcription-custom-message page; it refers to IT admins but names no administrator role.

claims.where: What's changing; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn does not specify the custom-message feature's behaviour in group calls.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams calling policies customize notification recording transcription custom message admin center group calls. Read feature and recording overview pages plus Copilot release-notes excerpt; general group-call policy coverage does not specify custom-message behaviour.

claims.where: controls[2].note; Scope: Calls; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: The calling-policy reference lists both custom-message parameters but does not explain their effect on calls.
claims.quote: Searched: Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy EnableRecordingAndTranscriptionCustomMessage RecordingAndTranscriptionCustomMessageIdentifier. Read syntax and both parameter excerpts; they give Boolean/Guid types without behavioural descriptions. Feature page excludes 1:1 calls.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: No new data access is documented for notification customisation.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams recording transcription custom message permissions role data access recording start stop. Read full feature page and New custom-message reference; they describe notification content and do not document new data access.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Learn describes no new permission, identity or sign-in behaviour for this setting.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams recording transcription custom message permissions role data access recording start stop. Read feature page and New custom-message reference; no new permission, identity or sign-in behaviour is described.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The custom-message setting changes notification wording rather than starting, stopping or blocking recording or changing who can record.
claims.quote: Use the toggle to enable or disable custom messages for this policy. ... Customized strings are visible to meeting participants when the recording or transcription is turned on.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Administrators can upload a completed CSV and use Preview to compare messages with defaults before saving.
claims.quote: Upload the completed CSV using the Select a file button. ... Use the Preview button to see how your changes appear. ... Once uploaded, the policy preview displays customized strings, with differences highlighted compared to the system defaults.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: New-CsTeamsRecordingAndTranscriptionCustomMessage creates a multilingual, multi-scenario message set associated through its generated identifier.
claims.quote: Create a concrete prompt message setting in multiple languages and multiple scenarios to be displayed to participants after recording or transcription has started.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: The New custom-message cmdlet reference still warns the feature is not fully released and the setting will have no effect, unlike the roadmap's Launched status.
claims.quote: This feature has not been fully released yet, so the setting will have no effect.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Meeting policies can be assigned to pilot users or groups and use normal meeting-policy assignment rules.
claims.quote: You can assign a policy directly to users, either individually or at scale through a batch assignment (if supported for the policy type), or to a group that the users are members of (if supported for the policy type).
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/meeting-policies-overview to sources for the meeting-policy assignment guidance.

claims.where: Open questions: iOS and Android
claims.claim: Learn gives no date for full iOS and Android message customisability.
claims.quote: Searched: "recording-transcription-custom-message" "iOS" "Android" date full customizability. Read feature page and targeted search excerpts; full mobile customisability is described as 'coming soon' without a date.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout and At rollout; controls
claims.claim: The checklist's policy-assignment checks and assignment actions have a corresponding control row.
claims.quote: Check which meeting policies your users hold ... Assign the test policy to a pilot group ... Assign the policy more widely ... Controls cover enabling custom messages, selecting message text and the calling-policy parameter, not policy assignments.
claims.fix: The checklist's 'Check which meeting policies your users hold', 'Assign the test policy to a pilot group' and 'Assign the policy more widely' steps have no policy-assignment row. Remove those three bullets to resolve the mismatch without adding a control row.
